response.content: Causal inference: larger system. The main difference between causal inference and inference of association is that causal inference analyzes the response of an effect variable | Rubin causal model: the "fundamental problem of causal inference." Because of the fundamental problem of causal inference, unit-level causal effects cannot be directly observed | Causal AI: Causal AI is a technique in artificial intelligence that builds a causal model and can thereby make inferences using causality rather than just correlation
